To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

local partner attributes, partner selection, and venture formation have a strong positive impact on venture performance; that project-related risks have a strong negative impact on venture performance, while host country-related risks only indirectly affect venture performance.

the performance of international construction joint ventures can be improved by (1) selecting a suitable local partner, (2) adopting a risk management strategy that addresses both local partner and project risks, and (3) ensuring that the local partner is involved in the formation and operation of the joint venture.

(1) The local partner selection process is a key antecedent of venture formation; (2) The local partner is a key antecendent of venture operation; and (3) The host country environment is a key antecdent of venture operation and performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an integrated model of venture success, which can be used as a guide to improve performance in international construction ventures.
how to improve venture performance through the selection of appropriate risk management processes.
the performance of international construction joint ventures and its relationship with key risk and success factors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the success of international joint ventures is a function of a combination of the local partner attributes, the venture formation process, and the operation process.
the success of international joint ventures is not a function of one or two factors but rather a complex function of a number of inter-related and interactive factors.
the success of an international joint venture in construction depends on a number of factors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the selection of an appropriate local partner and a proactive risk management approach are vital antecedent to the success of international construction joint ventures.
, while the selection and management of local partners are critical to venture success, the impact of local partners is mediated through their influence on venture formation and operation.
, the selection of a suitable partner and the adoption of proactive risk management strategies are the key antecedents to the successful performance of construction joint ventures.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the selection of a suitable local partner is the most important factor that influences the success of an international joint venture.
the performance of international joint ventures is a function of the processes that lead to their formation, and the risks that are encountered during their operation.
international construction joint venture success is dependent on a number of key processes, including partner selection, venture design, and venture operation.
